recs.blurb: In New York City, a crime lord's right-hand man is seduced by a woman seeking retribution.
Two brothers, on either side of the law, face off over organized crime in Brooklyn during the 1970s.
An Argentinian crime drama revolving around a sheet of rare stamps (the Nine Queens).
Elvis Prestley's first film is a Civil War drama.
A fearless cop is taking on a ruthless crimelord. He knew the risks. He just didn't know how far he would have to go.

A three-tiered story centered around drugs and organized crime, and focused on a young man who becomes a runner for a coke dealer.
A gangster named Perrier looks to exact his revenge on a trio of fugitives responsible for the accidental death of one of his cronies.
An elderly ex-serviceman and widower looks to avenge his best friend's murder by doling out his own form of justice.
Based on the true story of Jack DiNorscio, a mobster who defended himself in court for what would be the longest mafia trial in U.S. history.
An action-adventure story focused on the lives of express deliverymen, traffic cops and lonely beauties.
